title: 28th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَفِّرْ حَظِّيْ فِيْهِ مِنَ النَّوَافِلِ،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, decide for me a share of the supererogatory acts,
honor me by making me care for the matters,

verses.arabic: وَقَرِّبْ فِيْهِ وَسِيْلَتِىْ اِلَيْكَ مِنْ بَيْنِ الْوَسَآئِلِ،
verses.translation: and make near my means to You from among the other means.

verses.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يَشْغَلُهُ اِلْحَاحُ الْمُلِحِّيْنَ۔
verses.translation: O He Whom is not preoccupied by the earnest entreaty of the insisters!
